name: piston-moving-block-tick
comment: One sticky piston (29) at (0,61,0) facing up (meta 1) under a stone, with a dropped cobblestone item (spawn Item) resting on the stone. A torch (76, meta 5) beside it at t=8 extends it; removed at t=14 it retracts and pulls the stone back. block dumps of the three cells every tick show the moving block (36) and its metadata (the head's 9 = up | sticky, the stone's 0) during the two-tick move; entity_state shows TileEntityPiston.func_31010_a pushing the item up (moveEntity by progress step + 0.0625, then 0.25 on landing). Needs BlockRedstoneTorch (redstone task of WP-1.6) for the power.
